 Asset Description : 
 An air-cartridge filter is a type of air filter that uses a replaceable
    cartridge to remove contaminants from the air. The main components of an air-cartridge filter include the
    cartridge, the housing, the fan, and the mounting bracket. The cartridge is the part that
    actually filters the air. It's made of a porous material that captures
    particles as air passes through it. The housing contains the cartridge and
    provides a frame for it. The fan draws air into the housing, where it passes
    through the cartridge and is cleaned of contaminants. The mounting bracket
    provides a way to attach the air-cartridge filter to a wall or other surface,
    allowing for easy access and replacement of the cartridge when it becomes dirty.
